The '''Great Conquest''' was a period of [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] history, several millennia before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> during which the [[Species/Legends|species]] spread across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garban]] to avoid overpopulation and killed off all major predators on the world.<ref name="GG4b">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref>

==History==
[[File:Danchaf.jpg|250px|thumb|The danchaf creatures many Jenet myths focused on]]
The period became mythologized in Jenet legends, which spoke of brave Jenet heroes leading [[Army/Legends|armies]] of their compatriots against the world's [[Diet/Legends|predators]]. In particular, Jenet tales spoke of the campaigns against the [[danchaf]], or tree goblins, a species generally regarded as non-[[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] but depicted as highly intelligent in Jenet myths.

These tales related how the danchaf once ruled Garban's woodlands but were driven back by Jenet [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]], such as [[Chirr't Ferr]] and [[Rhet H'rrr]]. H'rrr, for instance, was credited with implementing the tactic of targeting the [[Gender/Legends|camale]] danchaf&mdash;the species had three genders&mdash;thus impeding their ability to reproduce.

Another tale told of [[Ch'irrk Felt]]'s creation of a giant trap made of pots, pans, and [[phospowder]], which blinded the danchaf and allowed Jenet [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to slaughter them. Although these Jenet forces failed to exterminate the danchaf, the tales claimed that their campaigns forced the creatures to devolve to the wild and uncivilized state in which they lived by the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

Although all [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologists]] but one, [[Xemlorn]], disregarded these tales as fanciful,<ref name="COTG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref> the Jenets did come to dominate their planet well before the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="GG4b" />
